snippet.title: Project Fallback - A Game Trialer
snippet.description:
Project Fallback is an 2D Pixel based Shooting game, where you are an robot sent from earth to take control of satellites from enemies.

Main developer : PradoshGame / helloImPR

Music from techtheist from Pixabay

Game is yet to be released.
Website and downloads will soon be updated.
